text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_transaction_id
Description
This command returns HTTP transaction ID.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_transaction_id
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert transaction ID: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_transaction_id]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
